Question Choices: Select which fraction is larger? 7/9 or 7/12 ~~7/9 | 7/12~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: Ninths are larger than twelfths of the same whole. Seven ninths therefore exceeds seven twelfths: 7/9 > 7/12.

Question Choices: Select TRUE or FALSE of the following statement " When the denominators are the same, the fraction with the larger numerator is larger." ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: TRUE. Equal positive denominators mean equal unit fractions. A larger numerator counts more of those units, giving a larger fraction.

Question Choices: Put the fractions in order from smallest to largest: 4/7, 3/7, 6/7
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: The denominators are all 7. Order their numerators: 3 < 4 < 6. Thus 3/7 < 4/7 < 6/7.

Question Choices: Fill in the missing number in the fraction: 1/2 = ?/4 = 4/?
Hints: Half means one out of two equal parts. If the denominator becomes bigger, what must happen to the numerator? For the last one, ask: 4 out of what equals one-half?
Solution: Multiply both numbers of 1/2 by 2 to get 2/4. Multiply both by 4 to get 4/8. The missing numbers are 2, 8.
